title: V8 robot pilot: monitor decision vs controller report vs telemetry standstill (UR5)
purpose: With the arm confirmed moving on fresh telemetry before injection, record the device-timed crossing and D12-low command, the controller's reported safeguard stop (host receipt), and the declared telemetry standstill criterion, keeping these events separate. Includes a brief-failure and a no-injection control. A pilot: establishes feasibility and variability, not a stopping-time guarantee.

conditions.purpose: sustained failure, fastest configured decision: stop characterization while moving
workload contrast at the same alpha: later decision, robot faster/further along the sweep
alpha contrast: slow decision (about 1.4 s) during motion
brief-failure control: expected to end before crossing; the sweep should complete without a safeguard stop
no-injection control: no stop expected; checks telemetry continuity through a full sweep

controls: brief-failure sweep expected to complete (ZKP alpha 0.3, 250 ms)
motion confirmed on fresh telemetry before any injection; otherwise no injection and the attempt is recorded as failed_precondition
confounds: Arm speed and pose at the decision instant differ between conditions (a later decision happens further along the sweep), which affects deceleration and stopping behaviour.
The controller safeguard-stop report is a host receipt time through the UR driver; it is not the electrical input time.
Standstill is the declared telemetry criterion (all joints below 0.01 rad/s for 250 ms, no gap over 40 ms); a different criterion gives a different time.
The electrical D12 transition is not measured unless an oscilloscope or wired input is added and aligned.
One D12 signal feeds both safeguard inputs in parallel: not a validated redundant safety design; lab safety review required.
Controller safety configuration (stopping limits, reset behaviour) is not controlled by this experiment.
Command phase and host scheduling as in the bench pilot.
notes: Proposed 2026-09-28. Requires Luke's agreement and lab safety approval before any robot motion. 15 trials; each includes an operator-confirmed reset and Play on the pendant.
